name: Agent Delegation
description: Lets an agent on this Mac ask another for a second opinion or a hand: Claude Code can have Codex review its changes (read-only, ending in a pass or fail verdict with the problems listed), or give it a task in a separate git worktree. The delegate runs in a tab you can watch, and its answer goes back to the agent that asked. Turning this on adds Octet's delegation tools to Claude Code and Codex; turning it off removes them.
author: Octet
